ambiguities.text: The index page lists modules without providing specific implementation details or parameter constraints.
ambiguities.resolution_strategy: Assume standard Ethereum execution semantics apply to all modules. Individual module specifications should be consulted for detailed behavior.

ambiguities.text: The relationship between state.py and state_tracker.py is not explicitly defined.
ambiguities.resolution_strategy: Assume state_tracker.py provides observability/tracking on top of state.py's core state management functionality.

implicit_assumptions.description: The fork assumes all clients have upgraded to Shanghai-compatible software at the activation block.
implicit_assumptions.impact_if_false: Network split with pre-Shanghai nodes rejecting post-Shanghai blocks and vice versa.

implicit_assumptions.description: State transitions are atomic and either fully complete or fully revert.
implicit_assumptions.impact_if_false: Partial state corruption could lead to inconsistent world state and potential fund loss.
